report: Some users receive a 500 Internal Server Error when creating an order.
expected: Bulk orders are accepted when their total is valid.
actual: Bulk orders return 500 after discounted totals violate the stored total constraint.
root: The service discounts bulk orders while the orders constraint requires total_amount to equal quantity times unit_price.
subsystem: order pricing service and PostgreSQL constraint
reproduction: Run the focused bulk-order regression after applying the patch.
verification_criteria: Runtime, source, and DB evidence identify the mismatch
